purpose: Teach: 付着/印鑑/コンペ/足場/自粛/増減/連覇/鉄人

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置に、本気で、絶対、ゴミ、絶対、付着しないよう、絶対、慎重に、扱え、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Ren — handle the lab equipment with absolute care. Don't let even a speck of dust touch it. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Measured, direct authority. Clear enunciation on the core demand. Warm undertone — this is guidance, not threat. Slight lean forward on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。書類、本気で、絶対、印鑑、絶対、忘れずに、絶対、押しております、本気で、感謝、しております
lines.en: Yes. I've stamped all the documents and filed them properly. Thank you for your trust in me.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight bow in the voice. Careful precision on the verb forms — showing competence without overstatement. Genuine gratitude, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会コンペ、本気で、絶対、君も、絶対、挑戦してみろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Why don't you try submitting to the conference competition as well? You're ready.
lines.style: Encouraging but not forceful. Open-ended — genuinely curious about his response. Slight pause before the push, like testing the water. Confidence in him underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の足場、本気で、絶対、固めてから、絶対、応用研究に、絶対、進みたいです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I appreciate that. But I want to solidify my research foundation first before moving into applied work. I hope you understand.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Polite disagreement without hedging. Slight weight on 'foundation' — he's thought this through. Respectful but firm about his own timeline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究、本気で、絶対、自粛、絶対、必要な、時期、絶対、慎重に、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: That's wise. This is a time that demands restraint. Proceed carefully with each phase, step by step.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Lower register, slower pace. Recognition that he's made a mature choice. No rush — the words land with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験結果の増減、本気で、絶対、毎週、絶対、報告いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'll report on the results weekly without fail. Thank you for believing in me.
lines.style: Earnest commitment. Steady rhythm. Each phrase lands like a promise. Slight formality in the verb choice — showing respect and seriousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会で、本気で、絶対、連覇、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、君なら、絶対、できるぞ
lines.en: Aim for back-to-back wins at the conference. You have what it takes. I mean that.
lines.style: Shift to conviction. More direct, almost personal. Slight emphasis on 'you' — making it specific to him, not generic encouragement. Warm finality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究、本気で、絶対、鉄人並みの、絶対、努力、絶対、続けてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll sustain that level of effort—the kind that builds champions. Thank you for this opportunity.
lines.style: Respectful close. Quiet pride underneath. Careful enunciation — showing he's internalized the challenge. Fade gently on the final phrase, like a commitment made.
